slides.title: What Happened Monday
slides.body: All three major US indexes rose more than 2% on Nov 9, led by chip stocks after last week's steep losses. Falling oil prices eased inflation worries.

slides.title: The Key Numbers
slides.subtitle: One-day change, Nov 9 close (%)
slides.body: S&P 500 closed at 7,549.94. Nvidia fell about 4% on a company probe, a rare exception.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: BLS publishes October CPI on Nov 10 at 8:30 a.m. ET. Economists expect core prices up about 0.2% on the month (estimate). No yearly rate will be published.
